title: Fix mailbox_host_loopback_rejected test with test-utils feature
description: kith-peer's is_valid_mailbox_host() has a #[cfg(feature = "test-utils")] block that returns true for loopback addresses (needed by integration test harness). But the unit test mailbox_host_loopback_rejected asserts loopback is rejected without gating itself with #[cfg(not(feature = "test-utils"))]. Running cargo test --features test-utils at workspace level fails this test. Fix: add #[cfg(not(feature = "test-utils"))] to mailbox_host_loopback_rejected, or restructure so the conditional is handled cleanly.
